headline: Language is humanity's superpower—it lets us share ideas across time and space
universal_truth: The ability to transmit complex ideas is what separates us from all other species
fun_facts: There are over 7,000 languages spoken on Earth today
Children naturally acquire language without formal instruction—it's built into human brains
Language lets us discuss the past, plan the future, and imagine things that don't exist
discussion_questions: What could you never communicate without language?
How does language shape the way you think?
What would human civilization look like without language?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: You can describe a sunset to someone who wasn't there. You can warn a stranger about danger. You can pass on knowledge you'll never use yourself. Language lets ideas travel between minds, across generations, around the world. It's humanity's superpower.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: Many animals communicate—bees dance, whales sing, monkeys call. But no other species has language like ours. What makes human language unique? What can we do that no other communication system allows?

options.text: We can combine finite elements infinitely to express any possible idea
options.response: Yes. With limited sounds and rules, we can generate unlimited meanings. That's language's magic.

options.text: We can speak about things that aren't present or don't exist
options.response: Displacement is one feature, but the key is infinite combination...

q1.title: Infinite From Finite
q1.script: Human language has a remarkable property: from a limited set of sounds and rules, we can generate an infinite number of sentences. You can say things never said before. Every sentence in this lesson could be completely novel.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Infinite From Finite"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Built In
q2.script: Children acquire language without formal instruction—exposed to speech, they naturally develop grammar. This suggests language isn't just learned; it's built into the human brain. We're wired for language from birth.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Time Travel
q3.script: Language lets us discuss past and future, not just present. We can plan, remember, and imagine things that don't exist. No other communication system has this 'displacement' feature. Language frees us from the immediate moment.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Language isn't just communication—it's the technology that lets human knowledge accumulate across generations. Every word you speak connects you to a chain of minds stretching back to our species' beginnings.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 93. Tomorrow, we'll discover when humans started writing. Until then, marvel that the sounds you're hearing are carrying ideas from my mind to yours.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Language Appreciation - Notice the Miracle
growTrack.learning_objective: Develop appreciation for language's unique power
growTrack.activity: Today, notice one thing you can only do because of language: explain an abstract idea, discuss the past, plan for tomorrow, or imagine something fictional. Language makes these possible. Appreciate the superpower you use constantly.
